scope.filter: Archived main input includes image and current input no longer includes image; current image icon is unknown.

method.baseline: Execute archived 8c456709 STATIC_MODEL_REGISTRY and modelCardSpecifications via test-support/execution-capability.mjs productBundle. All 9 archived files verified against the frozen SHA-256 manifest.
method.current: Execute current STATIC_MODEL_REGISTRY and modelCardSpecifications via in-memory esbuild and independently via node --import ./apps/web/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs; all 15 full-model and saved-ID results agree.
method.fetch: Fresh unauthenticated public HTTPS GETs using curl --disable, no authentication, browser-style User-Agent and Cache-Control: no-cache; no inference, paid calls, sign-in or examples executed.
method.timestamps: Actual GET completion timestamps; 2026-11-10 in Asia/Shanghai corresponds to 2026-11-09 UTC during this capture.
method.quotes: Verbatim source wording. HTML tags and script/style contents removed; whitespace normalized between text nodes. Markdown quote copied directly. Quotes checked as exact substrings.
method.limitations: Documentation evidence only; execution, account access and model output were not tested. A failed fetch or absent parameter is not negative capability proof.
